definitions.gloss: cinders; burnt remains; embers; residue after burning
definitions.explanation: The solid residue left after something has been burned, such as ash, cinders, or charred remains. Also used figuratively to describe something that has been exhausted or spent.

examples.japanese: たき{火|び}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燃|も}え{殻|がら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: To clean up the cinders from the bonfire.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燃|も}え{殻|がら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To dispose of the burnt remains from the stove.
After the fire, only cinders and ash remained of the building.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{燃|も}え→燃える：02312_moeru⟧ (the stem of ⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧, to burn) and {殻|がら} (shell, husk, remains). The {殻|がら} element appears in other compounds with the meaning of 'leftover remains,' such as {吸|す}い{殻|がら} (cigarette butt).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燃|も}え{殻|がら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to clean up cinders
- {燃|も}え{殻|がら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispose of burnt remains
- ⟦{石炭|せきたん}→石炭：03755_sekitan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燃|も}え{殻|がら}: coal cinders
- {燃|も}え{殻|がら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: cinders remain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{灰|はい}→灰：02244_hai⟧: ash — finer residue after burning, lighter than cinders
- {吸|す}い{殻|がら}: cigarette butt — the remains of a smoked cigarette, uses the same {殻|がら}
- ⟦{残骸|ざんがい}→残骸：30528_zangai⟧: wreckage, remains — broader term for ruins or remains of anything destroyed
- ⟦{炭|すみ}→炭：13375_sumi⟧: charcoal — partially burned wood that can still be used as fuel
